chunks: Hammad narrated from al-Halabi, who said:
I asked Aba Abdillah عليه السلام about a man who pronounced zihar against his wife three times, and he said: "He must offer expiation three times."
I said: "If he has intercourse before he offers expiation?" He said: "He must seek Allah's forgiveness and refrain until he offers the expiation."
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man performs zihar three times and has intercourse before expiation?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning repeated zihar, stating that each occurrence requires its own expiation. If the man has intercourse before expiation, he must seek Allah's forgiveness and abstain until he completes the required expiation.
